text:
Greetings dispatchers,
The duty planner sent an update on hand-off notes

Please review the latest guidance before the next handover, especially where passenger care, crate checks, and calm wording need to stay consistent. Clear notes help us keep each journey smooth for travelers and their animals, and they reduce avoidable confusion at the desk. When you pass cases forward, please keep the language simple, note any special handling concerns, and confirm that the safety coordinator has already looked over the route details.

For the pet cabin and deck references, use the approved wording exactly as shown in the shared materials. <<FACT F034>> Keep the rest of the file tidy so the next agent can follow the record without searching for missing details. If a traveler raises concern about comfort, remind them that our team is prepared to guide them through the process with patience and steady attention.

Also, please remember to align any follow-up notes with the current traveler file before you close the handoff. <<FACT F045>> If a case includes a pet with extra care needs, add a brief reminder for the receiving agent so nothing is overlooked. <<FACT F037>> Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk organized, reassuring, and ready for the next shift. Companion Animal Travel Desk
